newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Man charged with Irish journalist's murder.
newsitem.headline: Man charged with Irish journalist's murder.

text.p: A thirty-two-year old Dublin man was charged on Tuesday with the June 1996 murder of Veronica Guerin, Ireland's foremost investigative reporter.
Paul Ward, was formally charged at Kilmainham court, Dublin, court officials said.
Ward was already in custody on two charges of conspiracy to murder Guerin but both these charges were withdrawn, the court was told.
Ward said nothing when the charge was read out to him, police said.

Guerin specialised in stories uncovering Ireland's gangland underworld, especially the growing drug trade and people who enriched themselves from it. She was shot dead in her car by a man on a motorbike near Dublin last June.
